Container.Name: Optimizarr
Container.Overview: Automated media library optimizer with Intel QSV / VAAPI hardware-accelerated transcoding. Monitors your media libraries, queues encoding jobs, and replaces source files with smaller, re-encoded versions — all from a single container.
Container.Description: Automated media library optimizer with Intel QSV / VAAPI hardware-accelerated transcoding. Monitors your media libraries, queues encoding jobs, and replaces source files with smaller, re-encoded versions — all from a single container.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Temporary workspace used during encoding. Place on a fast drive.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI is accessible on.

Config.Name: VA-API Driver
Config.Description: VA-API driver name. Use iHD for Intel Gen 8+ / Arc (recommended) or i965 for older hardware.

Config.Name: QSV Device
Config.Description: Path to the Intel render device used for QSV hardware encoding.

Config.Name: Session Cookie Secure
Config.Description: Cookie Secure policy: auto, true, or false.

Config.Name: Secrets Key Path
Config.Description: Path to persisted encryption key for secrets at rest.
